name: CELLO
description: CELLO is a benchmark for evaluating large language models' ability to understand and follow complex instructions systematically. It includes eight features of complex instructions and four evaluation criteria with corresponding metrics, constructed from real-world scenarios.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for complex instruction following; it has some visibility in LLM evaluation work but is not as widely adopted as major instruction-following suites.
notes: Designed to address limitations of existing benchmarks in assessing complex instruction understanding; includes both Chinese and English-oriented models.
